newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish brewer in Russia, Romania ventures.
newsitem.headline: Turkish brewer in Russia, Romania ventures.

text.p: Turkey's leading brewery group Anadolu Endustri Holding is making preparations to start a $140 million brewery project in Moscow which will begin production in two years.

"We signed a deal with Moscow Municipality last week to construct Russia's biggest brewery with an annual capacity of 250 million litres," Tuncay Ozilhan, chief executive officer of Anadolu Endustri Holding, told Reuters.
He said Anadolu Endustri Holding's stake in the brewer would be at least 51 percent, Moscow municipality would get 20 percent and institutional investors the rest of the shares.
The Russian plant will produce Anadolu's leading Turkish beer brand Efes Pilsen and Russia's Knyaz (Prince) Rurik.
The Anadolu group will also operate an existing malt plant with an annual capacity of 43,000 tonnes.
Ozilhan said the Anadolu Endustri Holding group would also start building a brewery in Romania this year. The brewery is to come on stream by the end of 1998.

The International Finance Corporation and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will be Anadolu's major partners in the Romanian project along some institutional investors, Ozilhan said, but declined to give their names.
The company also purchased a brewery in Kazakhstan and was reviewing other offers.

"The last offer we received was from Sun Brewing Ltd, an Indian group which has set up five breweries in Russia," Ozilhan said, adding that the Sun Brewing Lts was looking to set up a partnership with Anadolu in which Anadolu would run the breweries.

The group is the major Coca-Cola bottler and distributer in Turkey and the Central Asian republics. It has Coca-Cola plants in Azerbaijan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Russia. These plants started bottling earlier this year.

The group says it controls 70 percent of the Turkish beer market with four producers -- Erciyas Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii, Ege Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii, Guney Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii and Anadolu Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii.
